sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Place *nem* before the finite verb to make a simple negative sentence.

Because Hungarian stress always falls on a word’s first syllable, putting nem right before the verb means it can get swallowed up unstressed next to a stressed verb — don’t let its shortness fool you into mumbling it when you speak. A negative sentence without a clearly pronounced nem can genuinely be misheard as a positive one.
